name: S. Somanath
summary: S. Somanath is an Indian aerospace engineer associated with major launch vehicle and lunar mission work.

facts.text: Somanath was chairman of ISRO when Chandrayaan-3 achieved a successful soft landing near the Moon's south polar region in 2023.
facts.context: The mission is a useful example of how technical leadership, team learning, and repeated attempts can turn failure into progress.
